title: 9 Things It Actually Costs a Godly Man to Lead
caption:
None of them are the title.

The apology, said first, before anyone else finds the courage. The credit, given away, even when the idea was yours. The hard conversation, had in private, not avoided in public. The job nobody's fighting you for, taken before the one everybody wants, because Christ washed feet before He gave a single order. Your Saturday, some weeks, because someone else needed it more than you needed rest.

The comfort of being right, traded for the harder work of being understood. Your reputation, risked, the day you correct someone the room won't let you correct. The last word, given up, so the younger guy gets to finish his sentence. Your own excuses, killed first, before you ever ask a man to kill his.

theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
